title: Exotic Earthy Jamaican Smoked Turkey Neck Tagine
description: A resinous and creamy Jamaican dish featuring smoked turkey neck, ferment-jang, and macrobiotic-friendly ingredients, cooked in a traditional clay tajine vessel.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a small bowl, mix together the ferment-jang, coconut oil, garlic, ginger, scotch bonnet pepper, thyme, sea salt, and black pepper.
Rub the mixture all over the smoked turkey neck, making sure to coat it evenly.
Place the turkey neck in the clay tajine vessel, leaving enough space for the onion to be added later.
Add the chopped onion to the vessel, scattering it around the turkey neck.
Cover the vessel with a lid and place it in the oven.
Braise the turkey neck for 2 hours, or until the meat is tender and falls off the bone.
Remove the vessel from the oven and let it cool slightly.
Serve the smoked turkey neck tagine hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
